name: LiveMySteps
tagline: Social travel journal: geotagged photos on a personal map, shared with friends
role: iOS app and web companion by the Softwhere team for KRIVI Associates

scenes.title: Every photo pinned on a map
scenes.body: Clusters show the most-liked shot with a count; search any place, browse by year or share the map as an image.

scenes.title: Location read from the photo
scenes.body: GPS and time come from the photo's metadata and become a place name; stories stay up for 7 days.

scenes.title: A calendar of favorite moments
scenes.body: Pick favorites for each month, see a year of covers at a glance, then share to private groups or by link.

scenes.title: Friends on the web
scenes.body: React web app with friends' posts, likes, threaded comments and one-click sharing to social networks.
